描述_EN: according to the inventory amn/ *10 dd 14, "before the date, the name of the Fatimid caliph mustansir (427-487)". above and below, two lines of a kufic inscription. above and below, two lines of a kufic inscription; on one side, bismillah ("in the name of god"), on the other, the date 448 (of the hegira = 1056). horizontal band, multicolored silks and linen, decorated with three medallions, two with red backgrounds and one with blue, each containing a griffin. fragment of tiraz, embroidery that adorned the robes of honor offered by the sovereign. in the spandrels, a double scroll motif appears on a blue background. at center, horizontal band decorated with three medallions each containing a winged quadruped.
描述_ZN: 根据库存amn/ *10 dd 14，"在日期之前，法蒂玛王朝哈里发mustansir（427-487）的名字"。 上下，两行库法铭文。 上下两行Kufic铭文；一边是bismillah（"以上帝的名义"），另一边是448年（hegira=1056）的日期。 水平带，用多色丝绸和亚麻布装饰，有三个奖章，两个红底，一个蓝底，每个都有一个狮鹫。 提拉兹碎片，装饰君主给予的荣誉袍的刺绣。 在翼板上，蓝色背景上勾勒出一个双卷轴图案。 在中心位置，横带装饰有三个奖章，每个奖章都有一个带翅膀的四足动物。
